newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wiener St'sche lifts preferred dividend.
newsitem.headline: Wiener St'sche lifts preferred dividend.

text.p: Wiener Staedtische, Austria's biggest insurer, said on Wednesday it would raise its 1996 dividend on preference shares to 28 schillings from 25 schillings per share a year earlier.
"Because of the high growth rates in the extraordinarily successful year 1996 we can raise the dividend for the third time in a row," chief executive Siegfried Sellitsch said in a statement.
The payout on the group's common shares will be lifted to 19 schillings from 17 schillings per share a year earlier.

Wiener Staedtische reported a nine percent gain in 1996 premium income to 17.3 billion schillings and said pre-tax profit should rise to more than one billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
